instruction.name: x86dectop
instruction.description: Decrement the x87 top-of-stack pointer (FDECSTP), wrapping modulo 8.

throughput.name: 8 instructions per body
throughput.asm: x86dectop; x86dectop; x86dectop; x86dectop; x86dectop; x86dectop; x86dectop; x86dectop
throughput.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 2000 --unroll2 8000 --iters 100 --warmup 10 --reps 10 --init 'li.d $r12, 5' --asm 'x86dectop; x86dectop; x86dectop; x86dectop; x86dectop; x86dectop; x86dectop; x86dectop'
throughput.notes: Consecutive copies chain through the internal top-of-stack pointer: 1 cycle per instruction, which is both the latency and the achievable rate.

notes: Consecutive copies chain through the internal top-of-stack pointer: 1 cycle per instruction, which is both the latency and the achievable rate. The instruction has no register operands, so no latency entry can be attached to one; the chain is over internal x87 state.
